status: MEASURED — UI starvation reproduced; exact scheduler cause not proven
scope: Physical Digitakt mk1 OS 1.54 V01D diagnostic + Pi 4B 128-frame kernel, USB1 track 1, Pi voice muted; disposable project

diagnostic_page.title: V01 DIAG
diagnostic_page.limitation: Maxima accumulate since reset; a fresh restart was used for each control/failure pair. The four-digit display saturates at 9999 ms.

before_play.human_observation: UI counters advancing; no reported lag during page reading

after_play_10s.human_observation: No new maxima reported; Play/Stop did not produce a visible stall

trials.reset: Digitakt restarted before setting the case

before_play.human_observation: Setting SPD above 32 and then DEP was extremely laggy; saving took a long time; interface already very laggy before Play. Reading the seven values took a very long time.

after_play.human_observation: Play took about 15 seconds to start; playhead LEDs were not visibly updating; reading the values took about 2 minutes.

derived_observations.interpretation: The UI task was delayed by seconds while the worker-entry gap remained 562 ms and worker batches were at most 94 ms. This supports UI-task starvation/CPU contention rather than a Pi playout or USB transport failure. It does not yet identify whether the priority-14 worker, a stock UI/save path or another device task caused the starvation.

evidence_classes.physical_measurement: V01 DIAG counters from installed V01D firmware
evidence_classes.human_observation: Encoder, Save, Play and UI responsiveness, including approximate delays
evidence_classes.source_fact: Worker runs at native priority 14; UI task is lower-priority stock task
evidence_classes.hypothesis: Dense updates keep the high-priority worker/CPU busy enough to starve the UI task; unproven until a controlled priority/self-wake variant is measured

limitations: Diagnostic maxima accumulate since reset; startup and page interaction are included before the first reading.
No timestamped device task trace exists; the counters show a gap, not the exact task that held the CPU.
The human delay estimates are approximate and not calibrated.
The Pi voice was muted, so this does not attribute the result to Pi audio rendering.
The control run was not explicitly confirmed as subjectively normal after Play; it showed no new diagnostic maxima.

safe_state.recommended_restore: Reinstall private/v01/firmware-V01D/Digitakt-I04R-previous.syx after the diagnostic session, with speakers lowered and the project backed up.

next_action: Restore I04R, then prepare a controlled diagnostic variant that separates worker self-wake from worker priority; do not treat the diagnostic result as a fix or a supported budget.
